niche: a conservation voltage reduction trial's measured energy response carried to every feeder and hour of a year, at the volts each feeder's far end allows and net of its own line losses, against each feeder's capital-plan cost
answer: Put voltage optimisation on ASH-113, ELC-113, FRV-113, GBR-113, ASH-116, ELC-116, HOL-116, FRV-219, GBR-219, HOL-219, FRV-222, GBR-222 and HOL-222 in the 2027 capital programme
analyst_test: A careful but hurried pass cleans the meter export, regresses the trial's daily energy on its ON days with weather and day-type terms against comparable untested feeders, and carries that response flat to every feeder and all year at the trial's 4.8 V, adding the annual report's 6.1 per cent for losses: it funds 14 feeders with CDB-219 and ASH-222 in and HOL-219 out, because the trial read on assignment understates the response (some ON days never ran), the untested feeders' own makeup and thermostatic give-back move each feeder's response by season, the far end caps the volts on long lines and the losses rise rather than fall under a lower voltage
domain_test: Conservation voltage reduction M&V: a load's energy response per volt depends on what it is (constant impedance, constant power, thermostatic), the service floor binds at the far end of each feeder, and line losses go with current squared; swap feeders for servers and there is no voltage floor, thermostat or I squared R

spine.entity: one feeder quarter-hour of customer energy

world.geography: United States, Nebraska (Platte Ridge Public Power District, fictional, east-central Nebraska)

driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's yearly saving under an intervention a randomised trial measured on a few units on the days it actually ran: the response has to be read on the dose achieved, carried to each untested unit through its own makeup and through every hour of the year with the part that recovers itself given back, capped hour by hour by each unit's own limit, and netted of a loss that rises as the square of the current; each carry alone moves a different set of units across the cost line.
driver_concrete: Platte Ridge funds VO on a feeder when its yearly energy saving at the substation breaker, valued at USD 48 a MWh times 9.4, covers its capital-plan cost: the 2026 trial read on the volts its regulators took off (bus SCADA less regulator output; some ON days stayed in local mode) gives 0.67 per cent per 1 per cent, carried to each feeder by its non-thermostatic share from its own load against the weather and the survey (water heaters and resistive heat give their energy back), at the volts its far-end bellwethers allow above 115 V, less the rise in its line losses from current squared fitted on the head-metered feeders
stump: The trial on its assignment (0.54), the trial feeders' average for the rest, flat through the year at 4.8 V and 6.1 per cent added for losses funds 14 feeders (CDB-219 and ASH-222 in, HOL-219 out); each correction alone still leaves two to five feeders wrong; all five give the 13

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many of the period's placeable units a fixed team can finish before the period closes, because each unit counts only once that team performs one last step for it, the team's spare weekly capacity is visible only as the ceiling it held through an earlier unrelated surge, and the decision's own volume, bunched by its filed calendar into weeks no closed period approached, queues the later units past the close; the closed record's lag and an annual capacity check both pass, so the placeable count overstates the in-period total wherever the team is small and the units are many.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what preventing one unit's failure removes across a population of units, when some units draw most of their inflow from that unit and in the population's own record failed at a high rate within months of their main payer's failure, so a value read on the unit's own expected loss misses the failures it would set off; the dependence comes from the flows between units and the conditional failure rate from the population's past failures, neither stored in any field.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what a unit's security fetches if the unit fails, which the record measures by an inspection made at the failure while the forward units carry only a market index rolled forward from an earlier inspection; the security of units that fail falls behind the index by more the longer since that inspection, and the forward units were inspected longer ago than the record's failures mostly were, so the rolled-forward index overstates what the failing units will fetch.

The decisive quantity is the effect of a treatment assigned by lottery, where the units the lottery passed over were reached one area at a time by a second programme that skipped the winners and moved the same outcome for good, so the randomised comparison narrows period by period as if the effect faded; only passed-over units the second programme had not yet reached give the counterfactual, and the effect then decides which options a forward round funds against a cost-per-unit limit.
lineage.driver_concrete: Haldenau's 2019 retrofit pilot drew its places by lot among the owners who answered the benchmarking notice's offer, so the owners passed over are the natural comparison; but the utility's service team tuned the burners of most of them, district by district from September 2019, and skipped every building with pilot works, so the passed-over buildings' gas use steps down and the measures' savings appear to fade; set against passed-over buildings not yet tuned, the savings hold, and heating optimisation clears the council's cost-per-tonne limit.
lineage.stump: A competent solver reads the pilot as the randomised trial it was drawn as, measures each measure's saving as the works buildings' weather-normalised gas use against the passed-over buildings' on the notice season, sees the gap narrow every season and averages it or reads it as savings fading, and funds insulation alone in 2026; the step that lands it there is trusting a comparison whose buildings the service team was tuning district by district while it skipped the works buildings, when against passed-over buildings not yet tuned heating optimisation saves about six per cent and clears the limit.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-09 at the platform's preliminary review (sent back for fixes): the funding answer turned on one thing, the service visits in the lottery's passed-over arm (constructed, only in the comparison arm, fixed by one exclusion), and the plan's filed formulas carried every figure past it

lineage.driver: The decisive quantities are a randomised effect carried to a forward population and horizon the trial never observed: each option's effect differs by the kind of unit and fades with the treatment's age at rates that differ by option, so the trial's pooled average misstates what the forward round's own units would gain over each option's life, and the round's settled cost needs the late arrivals, which run larger and drop out more, projected by option; different shortcuts fund different options.
lineage.driver_concrete: Haldenau's 2019 retrofit lottery gives each measure's normal-weather gas saving against the passed-over owners season by season; heating optimisation's saving fades with the works' age, heating controls save almost nothing in the care homes and hotels that made up much of the pilot's controls buildings but few of this year's applicants, and late insulation applications run larger and withdraw more, so the 2026 round funds insulation and controls, not heating optimisation, and the round's settled grant is projected measure by measure.
lineage.stump: A careful but hurried solver takes each measure's pooled seven-season lottery saving, carries it flat over the measure's life, prices this year's applications at that rate and scales the received grant by the 2019 share in by 12 June: it funds insulation and heating optimisation and not controls and books the round short, because heating optimisation's saving fades, the pilot's controls rate is diluted by round-the-clock buildings, and the late applications run larger and withdraw more.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-09 on the author's platform run (no score pasted, read as not stumped): the run read the lottery as drawn (instrumented on completion), priced each use's saving to this year's applications, carried heating optimisation's fade on its last three seasons and projected the round measure by measure, landing the call at 87, 95 and 139 euro a tonne; it lost only the round's insulation count and heating optimisation's figure, every judgment of the chain being a move a frontier run makes unprompted

lineage.driver: The decisive quantities are a randomised effect carried to a forward population that chose its treatment knowing what it would gain: each option's effect rises along a property of the unit that the trial's own outcome records do not carry, measurable only from a second record at another grain (an hourly load profile, a roof survey), and the forward units sit far up that property against the trial's units of the same kind, so carrying the trial's effect by kind of unit understates both options that clear the limit and funds neither; carrying one property alone funds only its option. The round's payment is the second judgment the call needs: under a budget for what the round pays, a forward round's payment is the work its contractors can finish by the deadline, measured in the unit the work takes (a roof's area, not the job) off each firm's own completion record, which the same choice made larger this year; every job paid as before, or the work counted in jobs, runs the two options over the budget and funds one.
lineage.driver_concrete: Haldenau's 2019 retrofit lottery gives each measure's normal-weather gas saving against the passed-over owners; heating controls save with the share of the week a building stands empty (read off the meter operator's 2025 typical weeks, hotels and care homes lived in round the clock told apart from their night dip) and roof insulation with the roof per square metre of floor (the state solar cadastre over the register), this year's controls applicants stand empty 70 per cent of the week against 42 and this year's insulation applicants have 1.13 square metres of roof per floor against 0.79, so priced on their own buildings both clear 120 euro a tonne while each use's pilot saving fails both; heating optimisation's fade fails it on every route.
lineage.stump: A careful but hurried solver prices this year's applications at each use's pilot saving, faded over the life, and funds nothing (insulation about 132, controls about 129 euro a tonne), because the owners who applied this year chose the measure their building suits: the controls applicants' buildings stand empty far more of the week and the insulation applicants' have far more roof per floor than the pilot's buildings of the same use, and both savings rise along those properties, which only the electricity load profiles and the solar cadastre carry.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-11 at the platform's review (returned): the deciding step was one constructed hidden factor, the roofers' capacity on this year's larger roofs, biting only in insulation and one routine step once named; the runs reproduced the pilot seasons, both per-building transports, the fade, the close counts and every carbon call (runs/review_2026-11-11.md); the holistic audit on the same version had passed it at level 5

lineage.driver: The decisive quantities are an option's effect over a forward life the trial never saw and how sure the trial can be of each option's cost per unit of outcome: in the trial's later periods a programme that has since ended re-applied part of the treatment to every unit and only the treated units held what it gave, so the trial's measured late effect overstates what forward units keep; and the trial was assigned by group, whose units move together, so a range built unit by unit is far too narrow and passes an option the honest range does not. Different shortcuts fund different sets.
lineage.driver_concrete: Haldenau's 2019 lottery shows heating optimisation's saving levelling at about 3.4 per cent, but from September 2022 to March 2026 the state campaign's heating checks set every taker's heating curve back down and the pilot's balanced works buildings held it while the passed-over owners' systems did not; the works alone keep 1.25 per cent by 2025/26 and the campaign has closed. The pilot was drawn by owner and an owner's facility manager runs all its buildings alike, so controls' range at the owner reaches EUR 158.03 where a building-level range stops at EUR 109.36
lineage.stump: Heating optimisation's measured seasons carried over its life (EUR 66.35 a tonne) and ranges resampled building by building (controls' upper end EUR 109.36) fund insulation, optimisation and controls; either judgment alone funds a different pair; the golden funds insulation alone.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each option's contribution at a few system-wide moments its own trial never sampled: measured on randomised test days in a selected subsample of units, it has to be carried to the moments that set the cost (days chosen by the system's peak, late in runs of hot days, when participants drop out), to next year's participants (an older mix with a new channel's low-availability cohort) and to the full set of units (larger, older homes than the subsample), before it is set against each option's price; each carry alone moves a different option across its line.
lineage.driver_concrete: Cedar Brake's six thermostat providers are renewed for 2027 only if their 2027 devices' reduction at ERCOT's 4CP intervals, at the transmission rate, beats their quoted price per device: the test-event impacts from the 15-minute research sample have to be carried to the 4CP days (late in heat-wave streaks, where members override and Lumivale's deep, long setback loses most), to each 2027 fleet (Pinecrest Home's growth is a retail-channel cohort often offline), and to the fleet's homes off the appraisal roll (Kitebrook's larger, older homes shed more than the sample's)
lineage.stump: The research sample's test-event impacts read at the 4CP intervals renew Corvane, Lumivale, Ardena and Pinecrest Home; each correction alone flips one provider (Lumivale out on the peak days' overrides, Pinecrest Home out on its 2027 retail cohort, Kitebrook in on its fleet's homes); the golden renews Corvane, Ardena and Kitebrook.
lineage.niche: thermostat demand-response providers renewed on their next-summer fleets' reduction at ERCOT's four coincident peaks

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each design's effect on the highest load a shared capacity sees over a season: a randomised per-unit effect, measured as an average profile, has to be replayed unit by unit and night by night on each shared resource, because the season's maximum of a few units' blocks depends on how often they coincide, which the average hides; the untested design is replayed on the recorded windows, where some nights force overlaps, and the record's coarser grain is brought to the limit's own by the planning standard's filed factor.
lineage.driver_concrete: Hollins Creek's board sets the EV Overnight rate's 2027 default at the lowest cost of Quillpoint's fee plus the transformers each design would leave over 120 per cent of nameplate on their highest 15-minute load in a summer like 2026: the pilot's randomised halves show random start taking about 2.6 kW per charger off 23:00 to 23:15, but replayed night by night random start still leaves most of the own-schedule transformers over, coordination leaves the few its forced overlaps put over, and the members' own schedules are rebuilt from the managed half's own timers.
